'''Ymir Flesh''' is a crafting material that can only be purchased from the trader [[Haldor]] after [[The Elder]], the second [[Bosses|boss]], has been defeated. It is used to craft two weapons.

== Availability ==
* Sold from [[Haldor]] for {{Item link|Coins|120}} after [[The Elder]] has been defeated

== Usage ==
=== Crafting ===
*{{Item link|Frostner|size=40px}}
*{{Item link|Iron Sledge|size=40px}}

A total of 23 Ymir Flesh is needed to craft and upgrade both weapons to quality 4.

== Trivia ==
* In the ''Poetic Edda,'' the body of the primeval being Ymir is used to create the world. Ymir's flesh, in particular, is used to create the earth. Therefore, it is possible that this is a pile of ordinary dirt.
* Prior to Patch 0.213.4, it was for sale only after [[Bonemass]], the third boss, has been defeated.

== Usage ==
=== Crafting ===
* {{Item link|Staff of Protection}}
* {{Item link|Mead Base: Major Healing}}

== Notes ==
* Blood clots can be farmed by finding and aggroing a [[Gjall]], preferably in a relatively flat and open area of terrain to afford the player room to maneuver, and keeping it alive: it will continue to occasionally spawn ticks in groups of three, which can be killed for Blood clots. This will require avoiding and/or blocking the Gjall's projectile attacks while waiting for it to spawn more ticks.

'''Early Axes''' are the first dual wielded [[Axes|axe]]. Its primary attack is a 4-step combo: two single hits, one with each axe, followed by two double hits using both axes simultaneously, resulting in a total of 6 hits. The final double hit deals 2x damage with each individual hit. Its secondary attack costs 16 stamina and is a leap forward, followed by a slash with both axes for a single hit, dealing 2x the damage. The Early Axes deal [[Chop]] damage and can cut down the same trees as the [[Bronze Axe]], such as [[Birch]]es, [[Oak]]s and [[Ancient Tree]]s. == Crafting == Early Axes can be crafted at a [[Workbench]] with [[Wood]], [[Leather Scraps]] and two rare components: * '''{{Item link|Curious Axe Head|nolink=1}}''' can be found inside a chest in variant 6 of the [[Abandoned House]]. * '''{{Item link|Mysterious Axe Head|nolink=1}}''' can be found inside a chest in variant 2 of the Abandoned House. {| class="wikitable" !Quality !1 !2 !3 !4 !Total |- !Slash |30 |35 |40 |45 | |- !Durability |175 |225 |275 |325 | |- !Crafting |1 Curious Axe Head

'''Liquid Frost''' is a consumable used to fuel the [[Frost Foundry]].

== Availability ==
* {{Item link|Ice|5}} can be converted to 1 Liquid Frost at a [[Frigid Kiln]] every 30 seconds.

== Usage ==
* 5 Liquid Frost can be used to fuel the [[Frost Foundry]] and harden a [[Cast]] into the final item. The hardening takes 50 seconds.
